$comment: Generated from data_director.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema`. Do not edit.

ChoiceOption.description: One option of a choice question.

option_value.description: What the agent reads back when the option is chosen. A string, never a number: a number reaches the agent as a floating-point value over A2A.

option_help.description: One sentence that helps the researcher tell this option from the others.

ChoiceOption.title: ChoiceOption

ChoiceQuestion.description: A question with a fixed set of options that a conversational agent asks the researcher in its reply, to be answered by choosing rather than typing. One or several options may be chosen, and where question_other is true the researcher may answer in their own words instead. Option values are unique within the question. Asking never suspends the run: the researcher may ignore the question and type (docs/specs/orchestration.md).

question_prompt.description: The question, as a short line a person reads before the options.

question_options.description: The options, in the order they are shown; between 2 and 12, with unique values.

question_multiple.description: True when several options may be chosen; one only otherwise.

question_other.description: True when the researcher may answer in their own words instead of an option.

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

description: The payload of a conversational agent: the text of its reply. An orchestrator's reply is grounded on its input and on the envelopes of the invocations it delegated to.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

reply_derivation.description: How reply_text came about. template for a rule-based agent, model for a model.

conversation_title.description: A short label a person can tell the conversation apart by, written by a model from the researcher's first message. Set only on a conversation's first turn, and only by an agent that declares it model-derived; absent otherwise.

reply_question.description: A question with fixed options the reply asks, at most one; absent when the reply asks nothing or asks in prose.

new_project_title.description: A name for the conversation's project, written by a model once it knows what the research or dataset is. The conductor records it as the project's title when the run succeeds, unless a person has given one; absent when the reply names nothing. Only an agent that declares it model-derived sets it.

new_project_entry.description: The Blueprint entry point (1, 2 or 3) a model worked out from what the researcher said, such as data already collected. The conductor records it for the conversation's project when the run succeeds, unless the researcher has chosen one; absent when the reply records none. Only an agent that declares it model-derived sets it.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: Reply
